spec.name: chip_profit_ratio_60d
spec.description: Amount-weighted share of the last 60 trading days whose close is below today's close: the fraction of recent traded value currently in profit (chip-profit / overhang proxy). High ratio implies profit-taking and crowding pressure, hence direction -1 for forward 20d returns.
spec.mechanism: Close relative to the amount-weighted near-term cost basis distribution; profit-taking overhang and crowding.
spec.formula: F_t = sum_{k=1..60} amount_{t-k} * I(close_t > close_{t-k}) / sum_{k=1..60} amount_{t-k}, over lags with finite close_{t-k}, amount_{t-k} > 0
